content:
Overview

Komárno is a city in Nitra Region with a population of 33,751. A historic town on the Danube at the Hungarian border, known for its Hungarian cultural heritage, the Komárno Fortress system, and its river port. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
